metadata.purpose: PACK-9 live two-app role-binding proof (repro-case, paired with NPDevSamples/pack9-role-binding-b). Composes the SAME labeling pack that dsl-conformance-max uses, but binds its role('curator') token to a DIFFERENT concrete role name than the sibling app -- proving PackRoleBindingRewriter's rewrite is per-app, and that the runtime actually enforces whatever concrete role THIS app bound, not a name baked into the pack.
